resources.string: Five waves of drones in the dark, and the drone that leads them.
Swarms, formations, shields and return fire. The Moth Queen waits at the end.
Clear the stage before it to unlock
• Fly: drag CyanBat with your finger. A keyboard or controller works too.\n• Pause: swipe or press Back. Back again quits to the menu.
• Fly: drag CyanBat with the mouse, or use the arrow keys or WASD.\n• Pause: Q. Press Q again to quit to the menu.

• Shoot: CyanBat fires automatically. Shoot enemies and obstacles, and avoid touching them or their shots.
• Health: every hit drains the bar under the bat. When it is empty, the run is over.
• Score: points come from surviving and from kills. Kills in a row raise the multiplier (up to x8), and taking a hit resets it.
• Stage up: kills earn experience. Each new stage lets you pick one of three power-ups.
• Waves: a tougher wave arrives every minute. After five, the boss appears. Defeat it to clear the stage for a big bonus.
• Stages: clearing the cave opens the forest, where enemies swarm, fly in formation, shoot back and hide behind shields. The first shot at a shield pops it. Each stage starts fresh: score, stage and power-ups begin again.
A Well Worked Analogy by Ozzed
Based on Beginning Android Games by Mario Zechner and Robert Green
This game has been developed by Martin Śmiech. It has originally been started as a school project and maintained as a side project since then.
More recent releases have been developed using Google Gemini and Claude Opus code generation assistance.
